title: Green Rule (Safety Gate)
concept: Non-negotiable safety gate: honesty must be speakable without punishment. If safety fails, content stops.
whenToUse: Always — especially when a topic feels dangerous, honesty feels costly, or ultimatums/stonewalling/retaliation appear.
steps: Name the safety risk in one sentence.
Activate Pause + Return with a specific return time.
On return, restart Warmth → Safety before the original topic.
Repair safety faults with an agreed phrase.

phrases.text: This doesn’t feel safe right now.
Even if I don’t like what you say, I won’t punish you for saying it.

working: A: “I want to be honest, but I’m afraid you’ll shut down. Pause 20 minutes — back at 8:10. I’m trying to stay connected.” B: “See you at 8:10. Not leaving — flooded.”
notWorking: “Fine, tell me — but if you say what I think, I don’t know why we’re together.” Content may continue; honesty is now punished. System learns truth risks abandonment.
activity: Each writes one safety sentence. Agree pause defaults. Roleplay one low-stakes dangerous truth; listener acknowledges impact without defending.
warn: Green Rule has priority over all content tools.
